title: Śrī Nṛsiṁha Praṇāma
summary: Prayers to Lord Nṛsiṁha, protector of His devotees.
about: Praises the Lord in His half-man, half-lion form, who appeared from a pillar to protect Prahlāda Mahārāja.
author: Vyasadeva

verses.roman:
namas te narasiṁhāya
prahlādāhlāda-dāyine
hiraṇyakaśipor vakṣaḥ-
śilā-ṭaṅka-nakhālaye

verses.text:
इतो नृसिंहः परतो नृसिंहो
यतो यतो यामि ततो नृसिंहः
बहिर्नृसिंहो हृदये नृसिंहो
नृसिंहमादिं शरणं प्रपद्ये
verses.roman:
ito nṛsiṁhaḥ parato nṛsiṁho
yato yato yāmi tato nṛsiṁhaḥ
bahir nṛsiṁho hṛdaye nṛsiṁho
nṛsiṁham ādiṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadye

verses.text:
तव करकमलवरे नखमद्भुत-शृङ्गं
दलितहिरण्यकशिपुतनुभृङ्गम्
केशव धृतनरहरिरूप जय जगदीश हरे
verses.roman:
tava kara-kamala-vare nakham adbhuta-śṛṅgaṁ
dalita-hiraṇyakaśipu-tanu-bhṛṅgam
keśava dhṛta-narahari-rūpa jaya jagadīśa hare
